summary: The Detroit Lions beat the Green Bay Packers 34-20 at Lambeau Field on Thursday Night Football (Sept. 28, 2023). Detroit was powered by its defense, a strong run game led by David Montgomery, and contributions from Amon-Ra St. Brown, Sam LaPorta and Josh Reynolds, while Jordan Love threw two interceptions. The note is a live blog with quarter-by-quarter updates plus start time and broadcast information.
one_line: Lions beat the Packers 34-20 on Thursday Night Football at Lambeau Field, with Montgomery's running and two Love interceptions proving decisive.
key_facts: The Detroit Lions defeated the Green Bay Packers 34-20 on Thursday, Sept. 28, 2023, at Lambeau Field.
Kickoff was at 8:15 p.m. ET; the game aired on Amazon Prime Video, and on DAZN in Canada.
Amon-Ra St. Brown scored a touchdown and mimicked the Lambeau Leap by jumping into the crowd.
Rudy Ford intercepted Jared Goff and returned it 16 yards; it was Goff's third interception in as many games.
Anders Carlson kicked a field goal to give the Packers a 3-0 lead on the opening scoring.
Jerry Jacobs intercepted Jordan Love twice, including a 20-yard return that set up Detroit; the second pick came at 11:04 p.m. and sealed the game.
David Montgomery scored on a fourth-down run from a couple of yards out after a Quay Walker unsportsmanlike penalty, extending the lead to 34-17.
Sam LaPorta, a rookie tight end, had a 35-yard gain and was described as producing at a historic clip.
Jordan Love threw a touchdown to Watson, ran one in himself, and had a 44-yard completion to Jayden Reed.
Aaron Jones returned for Green Bay; the Packers were averaging just 3.4 yards per carry before the game.
Al Michaels, Kirk Herbstreit and Kaylee Hartung were the Amazon broadcast team.
